snippet.title: FINAL FANTASY XIV: Evercold - Extended Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Warrior of Light─In shattered skies, wander not alone.

Prepare for Evercold, the next chapter in the ever‑expanding world of FINAL FANTASY XIV, launching January 2027 for PlayStation®5 | PlayStation®4, XBOX Series X|S, Nintendo Switch™ 2, Windows®, Mac, and Steam!

Learn more about Evercold: https://sqex.to/evercold_web
